LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_EnabledTooltip: Master switch. When off, textbooks do nothing and lessons behave exactly as in vanilla.
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_Matching: Only count textbooks on the subject being taught
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_MatchingTooltip: When on (default), a textbook only helps lessons in the skills printed on it, so a classroom needs a library covering what the teacher teaches. When off, any textbook in the room helps every lesson, and quality alone decides how much.
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_LooseBooks: Count textbooks lying on the classroom floor
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_LooseBooksTooltip: When on, unforbidden textbooks in the room count even before anyone files them in a bookcase. Books in a bookcase always count and never deteriorate.
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_DebugLog: Log lesson XP and saturation to the console
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_DebugLogTooltip: Writes one line per student per skill once a second during lessons, showing the effective learn rate, the textbook bonus applied and progress against today's XP budget. Useful for checking balance, noisy otherwise.
LanguageData.ActTx_Settings_TableTitle: Textbook value by quality (lesson XP rate / extra XP per day):

LanguageData.ActTx_Textbook_ClassroomBenefit: As a classroom textbook: +{RATE} lesson XP, +{BUDGET} XP per day for students taught its subjects.

LanguageData.ActTx_Dev_SpawnTextbookDesc: Drops a freshly generated textbook of a chosen quality next to this building, for testing classroom libraries.
LanguageData.ActTx_Dev_NotInRoom: That cell is not inside a proper room, so no lesson can happen there and the textbook will not be counted.
